author: LabAce
body: I bieve if it's listed as a stream in openstreetmap it cannot be fished.   Ponds, lakes and rivers fall under a "water" tag in Openstreetmaps and can be fished, while streams fall under a "waterway" tag.

author: PaleTear1123
body:
The body of water has to have white waves on it for it to count as fishable.
My OT is half in the water and it still tells me I  am not close enough. It also works at some points in the day and not in others. 
I get to my OT by wayvessel  since I  relocated it closer to water. I notice that fishing lines break a lot more as opposed to when I  am physically  near water.
